text:
Mayor Patrick Collins provided a high-level overview of the fiscal year 2027 budget reviewing
various expenses and revenues, the City’s self-funded insurance fund, and the additonal full-time
positions included in the proposed budget.

Chief Mark Francisco, Police Department, provided information related to the motion to add
funding for an additional Community Resource Officer. Vicki Nemecek. Public Works Director,
provided information related to the Fleet Maintenance Department as did Mayor Patrick Collins
regarding “internal” billing for services provided by the department. Tom Cobb, City Engineer.
provided infonnation on the additional GIS Technician position.
President Segrave and committee member Wolfe provided overviews of amendments to be
considered over the next couple of weeks prior to final approval of the budget including ongoing
funding for the Cheyenne Chamber of Commerce, a generator purchase for Facilities Maintenance,
funding for parking lot repaving in City parks, funding for surface water mitigation, and funding
for legal fees to assist with the handling of abandoned buildings.

Public comments on the fiscal year 2027 budget included Erin LaBlanc, Laramie County Senior
Center Director, who provided an overview of the past year and was available for questions. John
Romero commented on the Compliance Department activities and various other community
activities related to community members who are experiencing homelessness, Sarah Salas,
Volunteers of America, made herself available for questions. Additional public comment was
made by Michael White regarding the additional GIS Technician position.
Mr. Moody made a motion to call for the question at 7:36 p.m. however, he withdrew it before it
was seconded.
There being no further items for the agenda to come before the Committee of the Whole, the
meeting was adjourned at 7:47 p.m.
